method: Use only normalized GeoJSON coordinates and matching room IDs/labels/areas directly included in public viewer HTML. Raster availability is independently recorded; no authentication bypass or inferred room crosswalk.
limitations: All imports have bounded room or circulation scope; none certifies a complete current floor or building.
A shared metric scale inferred from rounded official room areas is a consistency estimate, not surveyed dimensions.
These layouts have no independent campus registration or reliable true north.

review.scope: Only the directly identified classroom polygons in the public HTML are imported. Floor patches follow these rooms; corridors, exterior walls and door locations are not reconstructed.
limitations: Room IDs, labels, areas and polygon coordinates are directly published together in the official embedded viewer HTML. The image tiles require login and were not obtained.
Coordinates are normalized separately by image width and height; source geometry is preserved under one shared uniform conversion per building.
The shared metric scale is estimated from listed room areas. Cross-room area agreement checks consistency, not independent surveying accuracy.
No campus rotation or absolute north direction is established. This supplement uses a local frame without geo.
Floor patches cover the sourced rooms only. Corridors, exterior walls and door locations are not reconstructed; floor height remains illustrative.

review.scope: 54 published space polygons imported (45 room objects and 9 area objects); four exact Facilities room IDs recover the scheduled classrooms. Three inventory service spaces lack polygons, so this is not a complete floor envelope.
limitations: Only L1 room boundaries are available for the four schedule keys 127, 133, 139 and 140; upper-floor classroom geometry remains unavailable.
L1 outlines consist of the exact available space polygons, not a reconstructed external wall or complete slab. Three listed L1 service spaces have no polygons.
L2 contains only the single published public circulation polygon (C)253; its small outline represents this partial coverage, not the whole second floor.
Native image coordinate frames are retained. Alignment between floors has not been independently established. The model has no campus geo registration or true-north direction.
The local meter scale is calibrated against rounded official listed areas; this is not surveyed dimension or current CAD accuracy. Floor elevations and heights remain explicitly estimated.
The viewer is a legacy public FIS source. Raster requests returned Login HTML, so no plan revision date or raster wall details are claimed. The HTML DC.Date is not treated as a drawing revision.
MCC 250 is corroborated by the Department of Communication Democracy Lab page, but is absent from this public second-floor inventory. Its floor remains inferred from the room number.

review.scope: 126 of 127 published fourth-floor space polygons converted (107 room objects and 19 shared/unknown areas). Classroom 4103 is an exact room-ID/label match. Public corridor 87238 self-intersects and is excluded; no complete exterior slab is asserted.
limitations: Public raster requests returned Login HTML. Native polygons are the geometry evidence; no raster details or drawing revision are claimed.
Only level L4 has recovered geometry. The other three current schedule keys are retained explicitly as knownUnmapped; they are not positioned on invented floor plates.
Floor outlines are the published space polygon parts, not a surveyed exterior slab. Unassigned polygons remain explicitly unknown areas.
Local meter scale is derived from published rounded room areas, not measured dimensions. Campus geo, true north and alignment to other floor plans are unverified and omitted.
The floor elevation and story height are display estimates.
The clear architect third-level drawing and low-resolution Senate fifth-level thumbnail cannot establish the missing current target rooms.
Public corridor ID 87238, (C)4107, has a self-intersecting boundary and is omitted from the runtime outline/areas and scale calibration; its unchanged original coordinates remain in the review.
